program: Hi Code Product-Grade Desktop and Industrial Workbench
principles: Runtime Protocol is the single source of truth
No fake buttons, mock-only production paths, or fake gates
Real, simulated, not_run, and external_required are never conflated
Every task produces tests, documentation, and evidence

programChanges.decision: Stabilize Provider, desktop UX, onboarding, diagnostics, Fusion, and Computer Use before deepening one ECAD flagship vertical.
